heat_stats.tags.description: Player tags, keyed by nickname, for any plugin that draws players.

network.reason: Signs you in, syncs your matches, and reaches the game's debugger on this PC

language.reason: Shows HEAT Stats in the FUSE App's language until you pick one.

game_config.reason: Needs the CDP port the FUSE App configured for the game.

storage.reason: Keeps your matches on this PC, whether or not you have an account.

secrets.reason: Keeps you signed in to HEAT Stats.

game_files.reason: Lists your replays and checks which game build can play each one.

files.reason: Keeps the replays you choose after the game deletes its own copy.

processes.reason: Starts the game to play a replay you pick.
